newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Snow blankets Cyprus, cuts off villages.
newsitem.headline: Snow blankets Cyprus, cuts off villages.

text.p: Snow blanketed the east Mediterranean island of Cyprus on Tuesday, cutting off villages in the Troodos mountains and stranding tourists, police said.

Police had to tow a bus carrying 20 German tourists which got stuck in snow at Karvounas, a mountain village 55 km (30 miles) west of Nicosia. They also delivered food supplies to some hill villages and helped in medical emergencies.
Residents of Nicosia, used to almost year-round sunshine, woke up to find the capital covered in snow.
"The last time we had snowfall in Nicosia was in 1983," said Kleanthis Philaniotis, director of the Cyprus Meteorological Department.
Cyprus's mountain region is more used to snow and even boasts some ski slopes.
